verdict.rationale: Highnote is API-first: core operations are documented as API capabilities, including card and account issuance, spend rules, velocity controls, account notes, webhook configuration and signing-key rotation via GraphQL mutations, and the full payment lifecycle. However, there is no explicit UI-to-API parity claim, and several functions are documented only through the Dashboard: inviting team members, managing user roles and permissions, and viewing or replaying events. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity, API-documented equivalents for Dashboard-only org and user management and event replay, and independent corroboration of parity.
